'''Kombat''' is a one-day duel tournament played '''Sunday, August 7''', with players seeded into higher and lower divisions. Higher bracket start at 22:00 {{Abbr/CEST}}, and lower bracket start at 20:30 {{Abbr/CEST}}.
The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld during the summer that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match.

Streamed by {{player|Badsebi|flag=pl}} at [http://www.twitch.tv/badsebitv BadsebiTV]

== Format ==
* Single Elimination Bracket
* Sunday August 7
** Higher div start: 22:00 {{Abbr/CEST}}
** Lower div start: 20:30 {{Abbr/CEST}}
* BRAVADO SKULL SHIFTER ZTNDM3 AEROWALK
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}}

== Rules ==
* Map order: cmd rnd for first pick. then p2 pick. p2 toss, p1 toss, remaining map as decider.
* European tournament (other regions are welcome but EU servers are prioritized for lowest ping (NA vs EU should be played on servers in Ireland/London unless something else is agreed)
* Client: ezQuake + unezQuake
* Same map can not be played twice.
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
* Walkovers given if opponent fail to show 20 min after match expected to start.
* Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.quake.world/ discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>, or message {{Player|Alice|flag=se}}
